mapper.sql: n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.type, n.top_flag, n.status, n.publisher_id, n.publish_time, u.username AS publisher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice_attachment na WHERE na.notice_id = n.notice_id) AS attach_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.publisher_id
ORDER BY n.top_flag DESC, n.publish_time DESC
SELECT FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.publisher_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}
SELECT FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.publisher_id WHERE n.status = 1 ORDER BY n.top_flag DESC, n.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notice (title, content, type, top_flag, status, publisher_id, publish_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{topFlag}, #{status}, #{publisherId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notice SET status = #{status} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_notice_read (notice_id, user_id) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice_read WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
SELECT u.username FROM sys_notice_read nr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = nr.user_id WHERE nr.notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY nr.read_time ASC
